real: add some text to tell the user to use space to select it.
prev_agent: With `huh`'s multi-select in the terminal: - **Space** — toggles an item on/off (checks/unchecks it) - **Enter** — confirms your selection and moves on - **Arrow keys** (or j/k) — navigate between items So the flow is: navigate to an agent, press Space to select it, navigate to another if you want, press Space again, then press Enter to confirm.
